subject: “The application took too long to respond.” error

messages.author: 26c72fac4d4b948b
messages.subject: “The application took too long to respond.” error
parts:
have a shiny server running (1.3.0.403) on Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server release 6.5 (Santiago) running in a VM. shiny package version is 

Some apps fail on startup with the notes that "The application failed to start. The application took too long to respond." Rebooting the shiny server allows the apps to work fine until the problem occurs again (within a day). 

Others apps are fine. The sample apps work without issue. 

We have a few different directories with different apps. For example, 

├── shiny-server
│   ├── apps
│   ├── sample-apps
│   └── tutorials

The peculiar thing is that the app path seem to be the issue. For example, if I copy sample-apps/hello to apps/hello I get the same timeout issue with the same app code (whereas it works in the original path).

Here is some output from shiny-server.log. 

[2015-04-23 13:26:13.851] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v1.3.0.403 (Node.js v0.10.21)

[2015-04-23 13:26:13.853] [INFO] shiny-server - Using pidfile /var/run/shiny-server.pid

[2015-04-23 13:26:13.853] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf"

[2015-04-23 13:26:13.886] [WARN] shiny-server - Running as root unnecessarily is a security risk! You could be running more securely as non-root.

[2015-04-23 13:26:13.889] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3839

[2015-04-23 17:04:26.945] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

[2015-04-23 17:05:02.009] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

[2015-04-24 08:57:42.628] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

[2015-04-24 09:01:22.050] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

[2015-04-24 09:14:46.438] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

[2015-04-24 09:15:03.521] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

[2015-04-24 09:15:12.445] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

[2015-04-24 09:15:27.045] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.

[2015-04-27 08:09:25.894] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

[2015-04-27 08:10:30.006] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

<snip>

[2015-04-27 09:08:22.194] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

[2015-04-27 09:08:23.675] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

[2015-04-27 09:08:53.410] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.

[2015-04-27 09:08:58.855] [INFO] shiny-server - Error getting worker: Error: The application took too long to respond.


The "exited" ones are most likely where I killed the session when it hangs. 

The typical browser output is 

   An error has occurred

   The application failed to start.

   The application took too long to respond.

   Listening on http://127.0.0.1:50503

I've seen this post and a few others but the sample apps are very lightweight and speeding up the startup of the app doesn't seem like the solution.

Thanks,

Max
